items.idiom: wear your heart on your sleeve
items.example: She wears her heart on her sleeve.
items.mnemonic: Она не скрывает чувств — сердце нараспашку, как слива: wears her heart on her sleeve.

items.example: Sales is perfect for a people person like him.
items.mnemonic: Продажи — для таких, как он, пипл-персон: perfect for a people person.
